offline: Awukho kwi-intanethi. Oku ukufakileyo kugcinwe kule fowuni, kuza kuthunyelwa xa uphinda uqhagamshela.
beta: Olu guqulelo lusavavanywa — amanye amagama asafuna ukujongwa. Ungatshintshela esiNgesini nanini na.
setup_uncertain: Faka into oyaziyo. Ungayitshintsha kamva; iinkcukacha ezingekhoyo zenza uqikelelo lungaqiniseki.
after_costs: Emva kweendleko ekufuneka zihlawulwe ngaphambi kwemali elandelayo oyilindeleyo.
rough: Olu luqikelelo nje. Faka iindleko eziqhelekileyo okanye uqinisekise imali oyilindeleyo ukuze luphucuke.
empty: Qala ngokufaka imali onayo ngoku okanye imali yakho yokuqala.
no_shortfall: Akukho kuphelelwa yimali kuqikelelwayo kwiintsuku ezili-14 ezizayo.
confirm_income: Qinisekisa okanye utshintshe le mali uyilindeleyo.
confirm_cost: Qinisekisa okanye utshintshe le ndleko icwangcisiweyo.
uncertain: Asinakuqiniseka. Lumka uze uqinisekise ngenombolo esemthethweni oyifumene ngokwakho.
safe_step: Musa ukwabelana nge-PIN okanye ngekhowudi yexesha elinye. Musa ukuhlawula ukuze uvule imali. Qhagamshelana nombutho ngenombolo ozifunele yona.
privacy: Susa ii-PIN, iikhowudi neenkcukacha zeakhawunti ngaphambi kokujonga.
missing_terms: Eminye imiqathango ayikho. Yifake ngaphambi kokuthelekisa.
above_limit: Oku kungaphezulu komlinganiselo osemthethweni wolu hlobo lwemali-mboleko.
loan_disclaimer: Esi sixhobo sithelekisa amanani owafakileyo. Asicebisi ngemali-mboleko.
stokvel_daily: Beka bucala malunga ne-{amount} ngosuku de kube ngoko.
taxi_example: Iteksi yokuya emsebenzini iintsuku ezi-{days} = {amount} kule veki.
unknown_fare: Asinalo ixabiso eliqinisekisiweyo lale ndlela. Faka imali oqhele ukuyihlawula.
